name: Bluebeam Revu
summary: PDF markup and measurement software widely used for takeoff on drawings.
differentiator: A markup tool first and a takeoff tool second. Basics ($260 per user per year) measures length and area only; count, volume and angle need Core ($330), and Quantity Link to Excel needs Complete ($440). It is the cheapest takeoff route here per year, but the estimate itself still lives in a spreadsheet.
pricing: Basics $260, Core $330, Complete $440 and Max $590 per user per year. Max is described as introductory pricing.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per user per year
bestFor: Small teams that already estimate in Excel and want to measure PDFs cheaply.
skipIf: You want takeoff quantities to flow into costed estimates and proposals automatically.
